name: Writing commands
description: Slash commands for everyday writing: summarize, proofread, shorten, rewrite plainly, translate and reply.

commands.name: tldr
commands.prompt: Summarize the text below in three short bullet points. Keep names, numbers and dates exactly as they are.

commands.name: proofread
commands.prompt: Proofread the text below. Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation only. Keep my wording and tone, then list what you changed.

commands.name: shorter
commands.prompt: Make the text below about half as long without losing anything important. Keep my voice.

commands.name: plain
commands.prompt: Rewrite the text below in plain, everyday words: short sentences, no jargon, the same meaning.

commands.name: translate
commands.prompt: Translate the text below into English, keeping its tone and formatting. If a phrase has no direct equivalent, add a short note. (Change "English" to the language you want.)

commands.name: reply
commands.description: Draft a reply to a message
commands.prompt:
Draft a short, friendly reply to the message below. Answer what it asks, and if something is missing, ask one clear question.

Message:
